source.title: Irish News, 21 May 1952, p. 7 ("Nominations for the local elections")
source.publisher: Irish News (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)

note: Triennial election of the district electoral divisions of Ballycastle rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. There was no contest: Patrick M'Auley withdrew in Glenshesk, and John M'Caughan was declared elected. A. Price, who had sat for Ballintoy for fifty years, retired and James Gault was nominated in his place. In place of Mr. A. Price, J.P., who did not seek re-election after fifty years. Citation restored to the original page: the 5 Nov re-citation pointed to an unrelated page (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
